'''Daniel Keegan''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Boston Grand Slam]] on 8 April 2000 with [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|Quiet Mining Colony]], according to Michael Hawley's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d496">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-10-kashyyyk-grand-slam-04-08-2000d496/ kashyyyk-grand-slam-04-08-2000], DeckTech (Michael "rayc" Hawley, 10 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-10-kashyyyk-grand-slam-04-08-2000d496/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
